_note: USD. Every number has a source and a date. Re-check before quoting; prices change without notice. Google prices are per GiB (the billing SKU unit is GiBy); Linode prices are per decimal GB.

wan.note: HiNet 500M/500M. Effective throughput assumed 85% of line rate for sustained object uploads; Day 18 drill 1 measured 58.2 to 59.7 MiB/s with rclone (about 98% of line rate), so 85% is conservative.

gcs.name: Google Cloud Storage
gcs.source: Cloud Billing Catalog API, service 95FF-2EF5-5EA1 (Cloud Storage), SKUs 'Standard Storage Asia Regional', 'Nearline/Coldline/Archive Storage Taiwan', 'Regional * Class A/B Operations', '* Data Retrieval', 'Download APAC'; human-readable page https://cloud.google.com/storage/pricing
gcs.egress_note: SKU 'Download APAC' (destination in Asia, restore to Taiwan). First 100 GiB per month free, then 0.12 to 1 TiB, 0.11 to 10 TiB, 0.08 above. The free 100 GiB is per account per month, shared by every restore in that month.
gcs.ops_note: Standard Class A has its first 5,000 operations a month free and Class B its first 50,000; not modelled.

linode.name: Akamai (Linode) Object Storage
linode.source: flat rate: https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-object-storage ('the $5 monthly flat rate (prorated) ... Billing for Object Storage starts when it is enabled on your account'); per-GB rates: https://www.akamai.com/cloud/pricing/asia-pacific (storage $0.02/GB, outbound $0.005/GB with the first 1TB free each month); 250 GB included with the flat rate per Akamai's object storage docs; no API request charges per https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/object-storage-pricing

flat.requests: no charge for API requests (official techdocs; per-request charges for E3 endpoints are being evaluated, not before 2027-10-01)
